draft.content_markdown:
## Project Summary

| Field | Current PMP position | Citation |
|---|---|---|
| **Critical current position — approval** | **Hold point:** one DA pathway is an architectural proposal assumption; no DA determination or construction certificate is in the supplied record. | [1] |
| **Critical current position — contract** | **Hold point:** a fixed-price builder proposal exists, but executed head contract, acceptance, contract form, certifier and statutory instruments are **Not evidenced**. | [4] |
| **Critical current position — cost** | **Control:** proposed fixed contract sum is $1,234,000 ex GST, with $30,000 rock-removal and $22,000 pool-interface-drainage provisional allowances; written direction is required for adjustments. | [4] |
| Project / owner / site | Kavanagh Residence; Kavanagh Property Holdings Pty Ltd as trustee for the Kavanagh Family Trust; 8 Paperbark Lane, Northbridge NSW 2063. | [1] |
| Physical brief | New two-storey detached dwelling, garage, landscape coordination and pool interface; external works. | [1] |
| Scale / delivery | **User provided:** 300 m², 4 bedrooms, 2 garage spaces; vacant, unrestricted-access site; traditional lump-sum working route. | — |
| Programme | Architectural proposal assumes 14-month construction; builder proposal indicates 48 weeks from site possession, approvals and executed contract. These are different programme positions requiring reconciliation. | [1] |

This is an owner-side, review-only Architect-PM governance plan. The architect-PM role holder and scope are **Assumption / Not evidenced** pending an executed appointment; it does not create Superintendent, Certifier or builder authority.
## Brief

**Physical brief:** new residential house comprising demolition, bulk earthworks, drainage/stormwater, retaining walls, foundations, superstructure including structural steel, roof, glazing, waterproofing, hydraulic/plumbing and electrical works, internal partitions, flooring, joinery, landscaping, car parking and fencing/gates. The builder proposal also identifies a two-storey dwelling, garage, pool interface, services, finishes and defined external works. [4]

Owner acceptance criteria are **Assumption:** approved planning and construction documentation; coordinated structural, hydraulic and services design; compliant, weathertight envelope; commissioned services; practical completion, defect rectification and occupation approval where required. Footing design must follow the geotechnical site classification and engineer’s documentation; neither is on file.

| Item | Position | Basis / source | Owner | Verification action |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Landscaping planting | Confirmed builder exclusion | Builder proposal | Client | Procure/retain landscape scope before tender award. [4] |
| Loose furniture / window coverings / pool plant | Confirmed builder exclusions | Builder proposal | Client | Confirm supply, installation and interfaces. [4] |
| Pool engineering and interior decoration | Architectural-service exclusions unless separately agreed | Architectural proposal | Client / Architect | Confirm separate appointments and coordinated documentation. [1] |
| Civil earthworks design / undocumented services work | Hydraulic-service exclusions | Hydraulic proposal | Client / Architect | Obtain survey, civil design and service information. [3] |

## Planning and Compliance

NSW pathway is **Assumption pending authority record**. The architectural proposal assumes one DA pathway, but that is not an approval. [1] Design documentation is to establish NCC compliance by DTS and identify any Performance Solutions for certifier assessment. [8]

| Due-diligence / gate | Current position | Owner / verification |
|---|---|---|
| DA, conditions and CC | Not evidenced | Architect-PM to obtain authority/certifier records before works. |
| Survey, easements and levels | Not evidenced | Client to commission/issue current survey. |
| Geotechnical classification / footing design | Not evidenced | Architect to obtain geotechnical and structural certification; reference AS 1726:2017 and AS 2870-2011. |
| DBYD / existing services | Not evidenced | Builder to verify before excavation; hydraulic scope excludes undocumented services work. [3] |
| Builder evidence | Proposal identifies a NSW licence number; currency of licence, insurances, levy/LSL and residential HOW/HBCF eligibility remain unverified. | Architect-PM to verify before contract execution. [4] |

## Programme

Baseline regime: **Stage 1** concept/schematic design to DA submission; **Stage 2** design development; **Stage 3** construction documentation and delivery. Builder’s 48-week construction indication starts only after site possession, approvals and executed contract. [4] Reconcile it with the architectural 14-month construction assumption before baselining. [1]

| Sub-milestone | PMP position |
|---|---|
| DA submission / determination / CC | Hold points — dates not evidenced |
| Tender, award, site possession | Hold points — executed contract and acceptance not evidenced |
| Slab / frame / lock-up / fixing | Monitor against accepted logic-linked builder programme |
| Practical completion / OC / DLP | Hold points — define contractual dates and DLP in executed contract |

## Cost Planning

The builder proposal states $1,234,000 ex GST ($1,357,400 including GST) as its fixed contract sum, inclusive of identified provisional allowances: $30,000 ex GST for rock removal and $22,000 ex GST for pool-interface drainage. [4] It excludes client consultant fees, statutory approval fees, loose furniture, window coverings, pool plant supply, landscaping planting, utility-headworks charges and latent conditions outside those allowances. [4]

Vertex’s fee proposal provides Cost Plan 1, Cost Plan 2/pre-tender estimate and value-management workshop, but the cost-plan output and owner-approved total budget are **Not evidenced**. [2] Maintain a change, allowance and forecast register; do not treat the seed cost taxonomy as a project estimate.

The Ironbark proposal is fixed-price and tender-valid for 30 days, but its acceptance is not evidenced. [4] Before award: reconcile tender set/revision, QS comparison, exclusions/allowances, authority responsibilities, programme, insurances and statutory residential contract requirements. Architect-PM verifies builder licence, insurances, levy/LSL evidence and applicable statutory instruments; do not certify claims or administer contractual notices absent appointment authority.

## Risks and mitigations

| Risk | Mitigation / trigger | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Approval status unknown | Obtain DA/CC and conditions before site commitment. | Architect-PM |
| Rock / pool drainage allowances | No adjustment without written direction and cost/time assessment. [4] | Client |
| Missing survey/geotech/services evidence | Complete investigations before final footing, earthworks and drainage release. | Architect |
| Scope exclusions/interfaces | Close planting, pool plant, furnishings, window coverings and headworks responsibilities. [4] | Client |
| Programme conflict | Reconcile 14-month and 48-week positions into one accepted baseline. [1] [4] |
| Builder engagement evidence | Verify acceptance, contract, insurance/licence, levy/LSL and residential eligibility before award. | Architect-PM |
| Owner changes after detailed design | Freeze owner selections before tender; builder programme assumes no changes after detailed-design issue. [4] | Client |

| A03 | Reconcile programme duration and milestones | Architect / Builder | Open | 2026-08-26 | [1] [4] | Issue logic-linked baseline. |
| A04 | Close exclusions and provisional-sum interfaces | Client / Architect | Open | 2026-08-19 | [4] | Approve responsibility matrix. |

## Internal audit layer

- **Facts:** Quoin’s proposal identifies the owner, site and new two-storey dwelling/garage project. [1]
- **Facts:** Ironbark’s proposal states the fixed sum and the rock and pool-interface-drainage provisional allowances. [4]
- **Facts:** Vertex’s proposal includes Cost Plan 1, Cost Plan 2, pre-tender estimate and value-management services. [2]
- **Assumptions:** The architect-PM role holder, approvals, certifier, executed head contract, owner-approved budget, survey, geotechnical report and most consultant appointments are not evidenced.
- **Judgements:** Treat the DA and construction programme as gates, not achieved milestones; retain builder proposal exclusions and allowances as commercial risks until a signed contract allocates them.
- **Recommendations:** Client to provide authority instruments to Architect-PM by 2026-08-19; without them, procurement timing cannot be confirmed.
- **Recommendations:** Client to nominate/execute the Architect-PM authority and contract form by 2026-08-19; without it, governance and claims roles remain advisory only.
- **Recommendations:** Architect and QS to issue a reconciled scope, cost and baseline programme by 2026-08-26; without it, tender award exposes the client to scope and programme drift.
- **Missing evidence and consequences:** no statutory record prevents compliance-status confirmation; no executed contract prevents confirmation of payment, EOT, DLP and insurance obligations.
- **Early escalation flags:** cost—allowance drawdown or excluded items; programme—approval delay or disagreement between 14 months and 48 weeks; procurement—contract acceptance absent; compliance—CC/certifier unknown.
- **Immediate next actions and register rows to open:** approval tracker, consultant appointment register, tender clarification/exclusion register, contingency/variation register and programme assumptions log.
- **Mandatory seeds consulted:** `seed/residential-construction-guide.md`; `seed/role-architect-pm.md`; `skills/reference/nsw-residential-cost-breakdown-reference.md`; `seed/setup-and-commission-guide.md`; `seed/contract-administration-guide.md`; `seed/cost-management-principles.md`; `seed/program-scheduling-guide.md`; `seed/procurement-quoting-guide.md`.
- **Workflow warnings:** unsorted inbox contains later hydraulic and QS invoices; file and reconcile them before relying on the fee-completion position. Current authority records, executed contract and appointment instruments require collection.
## Citation key

**Evidence on file:** [1] `01-fee-proposal-quoin-architecture.md` — 20 Jan 2026, unsigned proposal; [2] `04-fee-proposal-vertex-cost-advisory.md` — 24 Jan 2026, unsigned proposal; [3] `03-fee-proposal-flowline-hydraulics.md` — 23 Jan 2026, unsigned proposal; [4] `05-building-proposal-ironbark-main-works.md` — 10 Mar 2026, acceptance unverified; [7] `21-tax-invoice-catenary-structures-01.md` — 24 Mar 2026 invoice; [8] `ncc-reference-guide.md` — platform guidance.
